ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a line graph of the reaction rate of Russian tortoise gertimtonase changing with temperature. The horizontal axis is temperature (°C), approximately from 30°C to 42°C; the vertical axis is reaction rate. The curve is relatively low at 30°C and 32°C, reaches the highest peak at about 34°C, and then at 36°C, 38°C, 40°C, and 42°C clearly decreases as temperature increases. Reasoning: The information given in the question stem indicates that the ground temperature of the living environment of desert tortoises can exceed 60°C. For animals adapted to higher-temperature environments, their enzymes usually should show optimal activity at higher temperatures. Therefore, compared with the Russian tortoise, the peak of desert tortoise gertimtonase activity should move toward higher temperatures.

raw_record.question_text: Using the graph, predict how desert tortoise gertimtonase activity would compare. Would the graph's peak shift toward higher temperatures?

method.method_draft: First describe the graph: the Russian tortoise curve peaks at about 34°C and then declines at higher temperatures. From the text, note that desert tortoises experience much hotter ground temperatures, exceeding 60°C. Apply the rule that an enzyme in an animal adapted to hotter conditions should function best at a warmer temperature than the Russian tortoise enzyme. Therefore the predicted desert tortoise graph would have its activity peak shifted to the right, toward higher temperatures, so answer YES.

method.method_draft: First describe the graph: the Russian tortoise enzyme has low activity at the warmer end of the shown range, especially around 38–42°C. Then use the text that desert tortoises encounter extremely hot ground temperatures. If the desert tortoise enzyme had the same peak and decline as the Russian tortoise enzyme, it would perform poorly in its hot environment. Thus the desert tortoise gertimtonase should maintain higher activity at warmer temperatures, making the curve’s maximum occur farther right on the temperature axis. Answer YES, the peak would shift toward higher temperatures.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是“Russian tortoise gertimtonase reaction rate with varying temperature”的折线图，横轴为温度30–42°C，纵轴为反应速率0–50 nmol/s。俄罗斯陆龟酶活性在约34°C达到最高，约36 nmol/s；之后随温度升高明显下降，在38–42°C这一较暖范围内反应速率很低，约4 nmol/s或更低。推理：题干信息说明沙漠陆龟生活环境中地面温度可超过60°C。若沙漠陆龟的gertimtonase和图中俄罗斯陆龟一样在较高温度下快速失活，那么它在炎热环境中会表现很差。因此沙漠陆龟的酶应更适合高温，在较暖温度下保持较高活性，其峰值应向温度轴右侧移动。
